body:
Part of the `extract` feature. Plan source: task:a9d18cc6be1c2a2a note 17 (Task 2). Needs `extract --to-project` (task:96249ceddc889684, done) and `merge` (task:c741943383761e9f), so that every hint names a command that will succeed.

Investigation (notes 2, 3 and 6) found that no submit can reject a removal of a used symbol. Patches can't delete, module submits give E0102, and block renames save. So the hint goes on these two places instead:

1. **`delete`'s E5001** (`delete_all`): a removed symbol is still used, and a symbol with the same name and kind exists in another module of a project in the task's scope.
2. **A rejected submit whose errors mix two same-name types**, e.g. a type mismatch between `board.Task` and `solace_task.Task` after references were rewritten by hand (the board case, D-103's "Why"). Build on `callee_hint`.

The hint names the command that will work:
- The name is free in the target: `Hint: 9 references to board.Task now fail; solace_task.Task exists. To move symbols with their references, use extract board.Task --to solace_task [--to-project ../components]`. Include `--to-project` only when the target is in another project.
- A copy exists in the target: `Hint: … solace_task.Task exists. To fold board.Task into it and redirect its references, use merge solace_task.Task board.Task`.

Show it at most once per reply, and only on a refused delete or a rejected submit.

**Tests:** a delete of a used symbol that has a same-name copy elsewhere gets the `merge` hint. Where the name is free in the target, it gets the `extract` hint, with `--to-project` across projects. A submit rejected for a `board.Task`/`solace_task.Task` mismatch gets the hint. A plain E5001 with no copy elsewhere gets no hint. A plain type error gets no hint.

**Checks:** `rust-unit`.
title: Submit hint: point to `extract` when references to moved symbols break
